description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thirunelvely Central North, Nallur D/S Division, Jaffna District - Cad. Map No. 910001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership, parcel numbers, property boundaries, ownership details, and land-related encumbrances for multiple land parcels in the Thirunelvely area. The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4, with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
